name: Superlog
description: Reads Sentry and Datadog errors, reproduces them, and opens pull requests with fixes, using a memory system trained on prior PR review feedback.

skills.name: Error Triage
skills.description: Pulls logs, traces, metrics, and dashboards from observability providers to identify which errors are worth fixing.

skills.name: Reproduce and Fix
skills.description: Reproduces a reported error locally, writes a candidate fix, and opens a pull request with the change.

skills.name: Review Memory
skills.description: Learns from past pull request review comments so later fixes match the team conventions reviewers enforce.
